description: This file defines the NetworkChangeNotifier class, which manages network state updates and observers in Chrome on Android. It includes methods for auto-detection, manual state forcing, and observer notifications related to network connectivity, type, cost, and active networks.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages network state updates, observers, and auto-detection for Chrome on Android.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifier.ConnectionTypeObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing changes in network connection type.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance of NetworkChangeNotifier.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the singleton instance has been initialized.

methods.name: resetInstanceForTests
methods.description: Resets the singleton instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkChangeNotifier.

methods.name: setAutoDetectConnectivityState
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-detection of network state based on system notifications.

methods.name: forceConnectivityState
methods.description: Forces a manual network connectivity state for testing.

methods.name: fakeNetworkConnected
methods.description: Simulates a network connection for testing.

methods.name: fakeNetworkSoonToBeDisconnected
methods.description: Simulates a network about to disconnect for testing.

methods.name: fakeNetworkDisconnected
methods.description: Simulates a network disconnection for testing.

methods.name: notifyObserversOfNetworkConnect
methods.description: Notifies observers of a network connection event.

methods.name: notifyObserversOfNetworkSoonToDisconnect
methods.description: Notifies observers of a network about to disconnect.

methods.name: notifyObserversOfNetworkDisconnect
methods.description: Notifies observers of a network disconnection.
